# Naviamp 2.12.1

Naviamp 2.12.1 restores Jellyfin 12 playback when tracks are converted for streaming.

## Bug fixes

- Play converted (transcoded) tracks from Jellyfin 12 servers again. Jellyfin 12 turns off a legacy sign-in method by default, and Naviamp still used it on streaming links, so the server rejected those streams with "Invalid token." Naviamp now uses the method current Jellyfin servers accept, which earlier Jellyfin versions also support. Reported by [@tobycell12-beep](https://github.com/tobycell12-beep). ([Issue #730](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/730), [hotfix PR #PR_NUMBER](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/PR_NUMBER))

## Upgrade notes

- No special upgrade steps are required. Existing Jellyfin connections keep working after the update; you do not need to sign in again.
- Store and Flatpak updates may arrive separately.

## Known issues

- No new known issues.

## Thanks

- [@tobycell12-beep](https://github.com/tobycell12-beep) reported the Jellyfin 12 playback failure. Welcome, and thank you for your first contribution to Naviamp!
